description:
• Brand introduction:

We're a newly created online shop with a steadfast commitment to quality. Our mission is to bring to our customers meticulously crafted, one-of-a-kind products that resonate with their style and personality. 

We take pride in offering a wide range of unique and comfortable clothing options and accessories for everyone and mostly for gaming enthusiasts.

At Ultimate Game Wear, we understand the importance of self-expression and individuality. That's why we specialize in personalized clothing and accessories that allows you to showcase your personality.

What sets us apart is our commitment to quality. We believe that comfort should never be compromised, which is why all our products are made to provide all the comfort our customers need. This ensures that each item is not only eye-catching but also soft and cosy, making them also the perfect gift.

• Product description:

Gamers, it's time to give your room the ultimate power-up! Introducing our custom die-cut metal sign designed for all the passionate gamers. This sign isn't just a decoration—it's a statement. Whether you're into online gaming, player action, or the best online games, this sign will make your space feel like the best game in the world.

Crafted from 18-gauge steel, this sign comes in 5 epic colors: Black, Red, White, Copper, and Silver. Choose from 6 different sizes—36", 30", 24", 18", 14", and 12"—to perfectly fit your gaming sanctuary. The selected size is based on the maximum height or width of the sign, depending on its physical orientation. Please note that mounting hardware is not included, giving you the freedom to display it your way.

Our custom metal sign is perfect for showcasing your love for gaming. Whether you're playing games online, escaping into free play, or exploring the top games on gaming websites, this sign will be your constant companion. It's the perfect blend of cool design and gaming culture, making it a must-have for any gamer looking to personalize his space.

Imagine walking into your room and seeing your custom sign—an emblem of your dedication to gaming. It’s not just a sign; it’s a badge of honour in the world of gaming. Show off your gamer pride with style and let everyone know that this is your gaming domain. Whether you're diving into the best games, enjoying relaxing games, or participating in online play, our custom die-cut metal sign will always have your back.

You can add your name or your gaming name and hang it in your room or you can add you address ( postal number and street) and hang it outside your house or on your post box and let everyone know that there leaves a passionat gamer.

Specifications:

• 18 Gauge Steel.
• 5 Color Options (Black, Red, White, Copper, Silver).
• 6 Sizes - 36", 30", 24", 18", 14", 12" *Selected size is based on the maximum height or width of the sign depending on physical orientation.
• Mounting Hardware Not Included.

US ONLY SHIPPING (Continental US ONLY)

• USP (Unique Selling Point): Our Personalised Gaming Metal Signs are unique on the market, they were created by a designer to express in the best way possible the the love for gaming.

• Payment terms: NET30EOM. The payment will be due 30 days after the end of month in which the sale has been made. E.G. For a sale made on May 11th, the payment will be due on June 30th.
